companies.name: Decca Record Co. Ltd., Pressing Plant, UK.

title: Between The Buttons
notes:
Original UK stereo release in front laminated cover with pinched spine endings, on grooved blue/silver unboxed Decca labels.
Poly-lined standard company inner sleeve with record handling instructions, 'Made in England' and 'Patent Applied for'.
First catalogue number on cover, 2nd on labels.

℗ 1967
© 1967, The Decca Record Company Limited, London.

A1 appears on cover as "Yesterdays' Papers", but as "Yesterday's Papers" on label.
A6 appears on cover as "Cool, Calm & Collected", but as "Cool Calm And Collected" on label.
B3 appears on cover as "Who's Been Sleeping Here?", but as "Who's Been Sleeping Here" on label.

The Decca Record Company Limited, Decca House, 9 Albert Embankment, London S.E.1.
Laminated with 'Clarifoil' made by British Celanese Limited
Printed in England by James Upton Ltd. Birmingham & London.
Made In England By The Decca Record Co. Ltd. London

Labels:
• 'Mirage Music' on the right side, below Cat.#.
• No 'K/T' Tax Code [appears in runouts only]
• Side 1 / Design 9 / Version 1 (SLK4852/S1/D9/V1)
• Side 2 / Design 9 / Version 1 (SLK4852/S2/D9/V1)
• as per https://www.stonesondecca.com/the-60s-decca/between-the-buttons/ 

Runouts are stamped.

identifiers.description: Runout side A & B: UK Tax Code
